name: @chbrain/khai-composite-family-system
description: khai composite content, the family-system domain: the household read as one emotional system rather than a set of individuals -- patterns inherited down the generations, the system's resistance to change, and the one member who carries the whole's tension as its symptom -- across the inheritance, homeostasis, and identified-patient bridges over triangulation, differentiation, and double-bind.

khai.tagline: Family-system as composite: the household read as one emotional system rather than a set of individuals -- its patterns inherited down the generations, its resistance to any member's change, and the one it makes carry the whole's tension as a symptom -- across the inheritance, homeostasis, and identified-patient bridges over triangulation, differentiation, and double-bind, and the drama lives in the system holding its shape against every attempt to change it.

card.wire: Attaches at Process, over three atoms it declares as dependencies. The root (process_family-system.md) reads the household as one emotional system held across three engines: triangulation supplies the three-party binds that route the system's tension, differentiation supplies the members' capacity (or failure) to hold a self within it, and double-bind supplies the communicational trap a low-differentiated system lays on its own. The composite adds no fourth engine; it wires the whole-system properties the three become that none is alone -- the family as a unit, not the sum of its people.
card.issue: Three bridges, each a property of the whole the atoms cannot stage apart. Inheritance: the system's differentiation level and its triangles pass down the generations, so a fused, triangling family hands its children the same low differentiation and the same readiness to triangle their own -- Bowen's multigenerational transmission, cutoff in one generation becoming fusion-vulnerability in the next. Homeostasis: the system resists change to keep its equilibrium, so any member who differentiates or any symptom that lifts is met by the whole pulling to restore the old balance -- Jackson's family homeostasis, the family fighting to keep its shape. Identified-patient: the system concentrates its unspoken conflict in one member, who carries and expresses for the whole what it cannot own -- the scapegoat, the sick one, the problem child, whose symptom belongs to the system and not to them alone.
card.require: Two altitudes hold the composite. The law: declared once in the project's Instructions Knowledge chapter, linking the root, so the family-as-system read runs wherever its atoms are cast. The link, advisory: a plot may link under Tension the bridge it stages, and the audit surfaces where a play stages a family system without naming it.
card.enforce: Structure is checked; coherence is judged. The kit verifies the floor: the law is declared, the composite's own members conform, and every hard link into the atoms resolves through a declared dependency. Whether a production's family reads as a genuine system -- its symptom the whole's and not one person's, its resistance to change real -- rather than a set of separate characters, is semantic, taught and reviewed, never failed by the suite. It is authored dramatic architecture, never a diagnosis of a real family.
card.setup: Install the composite; its atoms arrive as dependencies and their laws with them. Declare the law in the Instructions Knowledge chapter, linking the root. Cast the system from the atoms -- its triangles from triangulation, its members' self-capacity from differentiation, its binds from double-bind -- then stage the bridges: the patterns inherited down the generations, the system's resistance to any member's change, and the one made to carry the whole's tension. Read the production as a system, never as separate people: the identified patient's symptom is the family's, and the family fights to keep it. It is authored architecture for a play, never a diagnosis of a real family.
